results.title: God Save the Tuches
results.overview: When Jeff and Cathy’s grandson Jiji is selected for a training camp with Arsenal, it’s a dream opportunity for the whole family to head over to England and meet the royal family.

results.title: Tinsel Town
results.overview: A washed-up Hollywood action hero is tricked into starring in a small English town’s chaotic Christmas pantomime, where a straight-talking dance instructor and his estranged daughter just might help him rediscover the magic of the season.

results.title: Crystal Cross
results.overview: A quirky Christian singer and a suicidal dad drive cross-country, forging an unlikely bond through bad decisions, bizarre roadside attractions, and an all-original soundtrack. “Crystal Cross” is a hilarious, bittersweet road trip about two lost souls finding comfort (but not salvation) in each other’s messes.

results.title: Rufus: The Sea Serpent Who Couldn't Swim
results.original_title: Ruffen: Sjøormen som ikke kunne svømme
results.overview: Rufus does not really fit in - in his community of sea serpents, he is the only one who can't swim. But when disaster strikes and their secret island needs protection, Rufus must face his deepest fear and save his family.

results.title: El rincón
results.overview: The lives of a loving family are about to change forever

results.title: Huntsville
results.overview: J.W. drives across Texas to pick up his old friend, Will, on the day of his release from a three year stint at the State Penitentiary. He brings along Will’s son, nine year old Cole, perhaps unwisely. Huntsville is about that first day of freedom for Will

results.title: Bandit
results.overview: Two bestfriend, Gatra and Tiar, plot one final heist in Bali to escape poverty, but when they discover a corpse in the stolen car's trunk, they're thrust into a deadly conspiracy. Now relentlessly hunted by both preman and police, they must rely on their wits and loyalty to survive the night.

results.title: Night Games
results.overview: A tormented child escapes into fantasies to save his alcoholic father and salvage his shattered family.

results.title: The Salt Path
results.overview: The profound story of husband and wife Raynor and Moth Winn, who embark on a 630-mile trek after being forcibly removed from their home. Hoping that in nature they will find solace and a sense of acceptance, they walk through the beautiful but rugged coastlines of South West England - a journey that is exhilarating, challenging, and liberating in equal measure. THE SALT PATH is a powerful portrayal of home, and how it can be lost and rediscovered in the most unexpected ways.

results.title: Movie Boy
results.overview: Thirteen-year-old Frank Pollack (Eastman Presser) eats, sleeps, and breathes movies. After receiving a camcorder for his Bar Mitzvah, Frank decides to make his own film, Zombie. "It's not a horror movie," he explains. "It's a murder mystery. It's Hitchcockian." But as Frank labors away on Zombie, he increasingly neglects everything else, including his friends, family, and personal well-being. Featuring music by Ted Leo and the Pharmacists, Movie Boy is a bittersweet coming-of-age story about passion, youth, and the love of movies.

results.title: I Wish You All the Best
results.original_title: I Wish You All the Best
results.overview: A non-binary teen is kicked out of their North Carolina home after coming out to their ultra-religious parents. As a result, they move in with their estranged sister and her husband. Though the two are welcoming, they continue to struggle with anxiety further exacerbated by their parents' rejection. As such, they try to keep a low profile at school. However, after they meet a proudly bisexual classmate, their life begins to look a little more hopeful.

results.title: Proyecto Agustín
results.overview: Agustín, a young man about to start university, chooses the same major as his friends because he's still unsure of his path. But when they decide to pursue their true callings, he's left adrift. In his quest to find his identity, Agustín draws inspiration from new role models… without imagining that they will come to life and lead him into a series of hilarious and revealing entanglements.

results.title: Bear Claw Camp
results.overview: An adventure with brave children, a talking skunk, and a villain with too much cement on his head, Maia and Jan, our protagonists, have one mission: to save the summer camp.

results.title: La Mugre
results.overview: Román Zegarra, amateur boxer, is rejected by a gym when it is discovered that he has never fought in La Mugre, the underground fighting event where all the men in the city compete. Pressured by his friends and by his family’s financial needs, Román agrees to fight in this brutal event. To do so, he recruits El Puma, a former wrestler who takes him to the tournament. In his first fight, Román ends up beating his opponent to death, becoming trapped between the horror of what he has done and the roar of the crowd chanting his name.

results.title: In Absence
results.overview: Family fault lines are exposed when the sudden death of a beloved wife and mother splinters a close-knit religious family. A quiet son on the threshold between childhood and adolescence, must hold together the fraying threads of his family, before an emotionally charged misunderstanding sees him take the fall as a result of an existential standoff between his father and a silent God.

results.title: Civic Duty
results.overview: In a speculative future, the “Agency for Solidary Coexistence” sanctions citizens who consume too many resources. Gitte, living alone in a house full of possessions, faces a visit from a government agent who gradually dismantles both her life and her sense of self.

results.title: Workload
results.overview: Three quiet workers journey through empty everyday paths towards the crossroads of life. A story about faces without dialogue. People who are disturbed by the emptiness of work. How does work become meaningful and a reflection of its creator?
